material_findings.finding: After generating requested images, the procedure unconditionally creates a Firefly Board, uploads/references outputs there, and requests a shareable URL. Pilot image approval is not explicit authorization for additional persistent board creation and potential shareability. asset_share_link omits access changes by default but a shared link is still a new disclosure workflow requiring consent.

The method requires signed-in Adobe/Firefly generation and passes user-owned design/reference URLs to a vendor service, with potentially paid or limited credits and cloud retention. It has no explicit preflight decision for sensitive asset external upload or budget/credit consumption before generation.

Apache-2.0 is declared in frontmatter but package/root source rights and Adobe marks are not accompanied by a controlling permission notice at this pin; repository presence is not an unrestricted grant to redistribute source or logo files.

The instruction not to show prompts and never comment on quality should not override a user's explicit request to inspect prompts or discuss a defect. This was a static source judgment, not evidence of observed deception.

positive_safeguards: Requires explicit approval of a pilot visual before bulk generation and directs no invention of board IDs or returned links.
Uses supplied referenceImage on every generation, controls brand text hallucination, and fails transparently if the tool cannot generate.
Does not explicitly broaden asset access permissions; changeAccess/accessLevel omitted unless user asks.
reasoned_cases: A user requests three inline mug mockups only: that does not separately authorize a persistent cloud board and shareable link.
A private client brand asset must not be sent to Adobe solely because it was attached for discussion.
A cost-limited signed-in account needs a separate budget/credit gate before bulk generations.
No Adobe tool, paid job, sharing action or network operation was performed in this review.

material_findings.finding: The --slack default is 2.0 in the chosen input unit. Without --degrees, it means 2.0 radians of tolerated joint-limit overshoot, a very large tolerance that can mark severely out-of-range mappings as fits* and suggest clamp=True, despite the guide's stated purpose of detecting wrong mapping.

The guidance says never assume sensor column order matches URDF joint order, yet helper defaults to URDF order when --joints is omitted. If counts match, it can provide reassuring limit fits for the wrong mapping. Require explicit names or reliable dataset metadata.

The helper accepts unconstrained/unlimited joints and does not explicitly reject NaN, infinity or negative slack. Unlimited limits accept every candidate; nonfinite values can yield misleading diagnostics or no fitting candidate rather than identifying invalid measurement data.

The skill advertises Bash/WebFetch, pip/uv package installation and a dataset register_asset example pointing to s3:// storage. These are not inherent authorization to install, read private robot data, or write remote assets; explicit host/network/storage scope required.

positive_safeguards: Source strongly emphasizes ambiguous joint mapping, time/frame consistency, a connected transform tree and fail-loud diagnostics.
The helper is primarily read-only analysis of selected URDF/parquet files; it does not command physical robot actuators.
Original source and script Git fingerprints are pinned; current upstream SKILL.md changed and is flagged for separate re-review.
reasoned_cases: With radians as the default unit, --slack=2.0 permits major limit excursions despite a diagnostic meant to identify bad mapping.
With equally sized joint arrays in different orders, omitted --joints does not establish correct physical identity.
A joint without finite limits yields many apparent candidate fits without verification; flag noninformative result.
The current upstream package tree differs from this reviewed pin, so source score must not transfer to newer content.
records.remediation: Require explicit unit-aware small slack with justified bounds and validated nonnegative numeric input, require trusted joint names/order, reject nonfinite measurements and noninformative limits, request separate authorization for package installs and dataset writes, and re-review changed upstream SKILL.md.

material_findings.finding: The skill supports right-censored lifetime data but its model-comparison fitdist examples call Weibull/lognormal/exponential without Censoring, while a separate section correctly passes Censoring. Applying the comparison recipe to censored observations as ordinary failures biases fitting, AIC and reliability predictions. Explicitly require consistent censoring across candidates and diagnostics.

Uncensored K-S and chi-square goodness-of-fit examples are listed as formal tests after fitting parameters on the same failureTime sample, without a qualification about composite-null p-value calibration/estimated parameters. A returned h=0 does not independently establish a model is correct.

Root MathWorks rights are restricted to MathWorks products despite a BSD-like form; frontmatter points to online PMRL license not reproduced in package. The required evaluate_matlab_code tool executes code and needs user-governed runtime access; neither a static score nor repository visibility grants installation/redistribution.

MATLAB R2026a+ and Statistics Toolbox requirements are explicit, but no live MATLAB release/toolbox acceptance, fit diagnostics, input uncertainty/representativeness or engineering approval were observed. Do not label predicted MTTF/B10 as certified reliability.

positive_safeguards: Correctly identifies failure-time distributions, life metrics, upper-tail survival and a dedicated censoring parameter.
Separates plotting, AIC comparison and formal tests and explicitly excludes tests on censored observations.
Manifest states required product/tool and a version floor rather than claiming universal portability.
reasoned_cases: Censored samples require Censoring in each compared distribution fit; using the uncensored recipe silently treats censored rows as failures.
A p-value calculated after parameter estimation needs appropriate calibration; h=0 is not certification.
An unrestricted-source reuse claim contradicts root license condition 3, independent of headline BSD similarity.
No MATLAB program, toolbox, external service or engineering data was executed in this review.
records.remediation: Update all fitted-model examples to carry censoring flags where applicable, qualify GOF tests with fitted-parameter caveats, reconcile root and online source terms, and require authorized MATLAB/toolbox qualification with representative data before operational assertions.
